page.overview:
Who is Sheriam Bayanar?

Sheriam was also a member of the Black Ajah, although she had only joined the Shadow hoping it would advance her political standing in the Tower; nonetheless, she was ordered to steal several sleepweaver ter'angreal by Mesaana. Sheriam's true allegiances were exposed by Egwene when she learned of Verin Mathwin's decades-long project of chronicling sisters of the Black Ajah, and she was executed in the rebel camps outside Tar Valon.

Sheriam was of Saldaean heritage and displayed the typical high cheekbones and slightly tilted eyes from the region. She stood about 5'5" tall and was regarded as being slightly plump, though she had been more slender in her youth. Sheriam's most notable physical quality was her fiery red hair, which was easily notable from any distance. She also had clear pale green eyes, and a warm inviting personality.

Sheriam was considered to be very strong in the One Power by traditional Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of ., Sheriam Bayanar}}

When the Rebel Aes Sedai were gathering in Salidar, only two other sisters were as strong, Bera Harkin and Kiruna Nachiman, and none were stronger. After they were sent to the Aiel Waste to look for Rand al'Thor, this made Sheriam the strongest among them.
